summary: National Storage Affiliates Trust (NSA) filed an 8-K announcing an anticipated closing date for a pending transaction with Public Storage, alongside a dividend declaration linked to the deal. The filing references Rule 425 communications, indicating a merger agreement is in place. Terms such as price per share, premium, and break fee are not disclosed in this update. The board's recommendation and advisors are not specified. The transaction appears to be an all-cash or cash-plus-stock acquisition of NSA by Public Storage, pending regulatory and shareholder approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competing bids; the risk-arb spread will tighten as the closing date approaches.
